title: heptapleurum zhuanum
intro: Heptapleurum zhuanum, commonly known as Seven-kingdom Tree or Seven-kingdom Plant, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, traditionally used in herbal medicine. It has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in relieving fever, reducing pain and inflammation, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Heptapleurum zhuanum include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, and demonstrate antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities. The bioactive constituents of Heptapleurum zhuanum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
